value.rationale: The source has a geometrically fixed pair of equilibrium circles but varied nonlinear dynamical regimes. An exact complete two-parameter census of linearly nilpotent points is a natural invariant of their local dynamical organization. The four-neutral-point phase, two sharp fold curves and their unique cusp are mathematically meaningful structural boundaries and not arbitrary slices or routine single-equilibrium checks. The third parameter disappears at first order, a useful simplification for future local analysis.
